subject: Contract redlines and coordination — scheduling meeting to review

From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>

Cc: Bob Singh <bob.singh@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com, legal@acme.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract redlines — can we schedule a review?

Hi Marissa / Avery,

Thanks for sending over the redlines. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed and have a few open items they'd like to walk through live rather than over email. Can we schedule a 45–60 minute session this week to go through the redlines and identify blockers?

Attendees from our side: myself (procurement), Bob Singh (platform engineer), and legal@acme.com (in-house counsel). Please include whoever from your legal and SE teams should be present.

Attached: ACME_contract_redlines_v1.pdf (high level summary + inline comments).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 7/14 10:00–11:00
- Wed 7/15 14:00–15:00
- Thu 7/16 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, please suggest alternatives. We’re aiming to finalize before the 7/23 procurement cutover.

Best,
Alice
Alice Jenkins
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Bob Singh <bob.singh@acme.com>, legal@acme.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract redlines — can we schedule a review?

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and for the attachment.

We can absolutely set up a live redline review. Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (AE), Avery (SE) to walk through any integration/technical asks, Marcus (Legal) for contract discussion, and Neha (Security) for any data/security items your counsel may flag.

Of your proposed windows, Tue 7/14 10:00–11:00 PST works best for our team. I’ll hold that slot tentatively. Agenda suggestion:
- 5m quick intros
- 25–30m line-by-line redline review (focus on material changes)
- 10–15m procurement/legal Qs and next steps (DocuSign timeline, SOW follow-ups)

Attached: meeting-agenda.docx (draft). Also happy to add any additional docs you want covered.

If we need to expand to 60m we can. Would you like us to send a calendar invite with a shared drive folder and DocuSign link placeholders?

Thanks — I’ll create the invite once you confirm.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi all,

I can join Tue 7/14 10:00 PST. For the technical portion, Bob, could you invite any additional engineers who’ll need to be on the call (networking/auth infra/etc.)? I’ll prepare a short runbook of integration touchpoints and known tradeoffs related to the SLA/retention language so we can answer questions live.

Also attaching a redline-summary.xlsx with the SE-level implications per clause (performance, KV cache semantics, data residency notes).

Thanks,

Hi Marissa — sorry, an internal scheduling conflict just came up for Tue 7/14 at 10am. Can we move to one of these options instead?

- Wed 7/15 14:00–15:00 PST (preferred)
- Thu 7/16 09:00–10:00 PST
- Fri 7/17 11:00–12:00 PST (backup)

If Wed 7/15 at 14:00 works, please go ahead and send an invite — Bob and legal will be available then.

Subject: Re: Contract redlines — confirmed Wed 7/15 14:00 PST — calendar invite sent

Thanks for the update, Alice — Wed 7/15 14:00 PST works for us. I’ve sent a calendar invite titled “ACME — Contract redline review (Marissa / Acme)” for 7/15 14:00–15:00 PST with a Google Meet link and a shared Drive folder containing the materials referenced (ACME_contract_redlines_v1.pdf, meeting-agenda.docx, redline-summary.xlsx).

Action items before the call:
- Acme legal: mark any top-three non-starters so we can prioritize those in the first 15 minutes.
- Acme SEs: share any architecture diagrams that affect SLA/data clauses to the shared Drive folder.
- Redwood (Marcus): bring suggested language alternatives for the top procurement asks (limitation of liability, data retention, SLA credits).

DocuSign/process note: If we resolve language in the call, Redwood legal can prepare a tracked-change contract and circulate via DocuSign for countersignature. If procurement needs more time, propose a brief follow-up slot for final signoff.

I’ve attached the invite file stub and will update the Drive link in the HubSpot deal record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ACME-0421
